newsitem.title: USA: Moody's may cut Sheveport, La. Housing Authority.
newsitem.headline: Moody's may cut Sheveport, La. Housing Authority.

text.p: MOODY'S PLACES HOUSING AUTHORITY OF THE CITY OF SHREVEPORT, LOUISIANA TAXABLE MORTGAGE REVENUE BONDS (CLEAR HORIZONS APARTMENT PROJECT), SERIES 1993 UNDER REVIEW FOR POTENTIAL DOWNGRADE; APPROXIMATELY $1.235 MILLIONOF DEBT SECURITIES AFFECTED

NEW YORK, July 22, 1997 -- Effective today, Moody's Investors Service placed the Housing Authority of the City of Shreveport, Louisiana Taxable Mortgage Revenue Bonds (Clear Horizons Apartments Project) Series 1993, currently rated A, under review for potential downgrade. The amount of debt affected is $1.235 million.

The bonds are being placed under review for possible downgrade based on poor financial performance with insufficient debt service coverage for fiscal year 1996 and rising expenses accompanied by a slight decrease in revenues.

In its review, Moody's will consider whether the poor financial performance of 1996 is likely to continue during 1997 and beyond. Furthermore, the ability of the project to reduce expenses in future periods will be a key consideration when assessing the bond issue. ANALYSTS:
Brian Liloia, Analyst, Public Finance Group, Moody's Investors Service
